body.estimand_functional: The finite-sample confidence outputs are \(C_n^{\mathrm{proj}}(\alpha)\) and the oracle-adaptive \(C_n^{\mathrm{ad}}(\alpha)\). The finite local weak-separation benchmark is the score-only, bounded-effect-spread Gaussian minimax risk of Definition def:score-face-minimax-risk, which observes \(b\) exactly; the unbounded full-vector risk \(\mathfrak R_{\alpha}^{G}(H,\Omega)\) is retained only as an infinite-frontier obstruction.

sampling_model.design: There are fixed finite treated groups and a fixed finite menu of prespecified donor stacks with known weights. Each score is the treated-minus-donor contrast in baseline levels, pre-period slopes, and case-mix summaries. For adaptive inference, the first \(m_n\) iid observations in every primitive group form an independent pilot with \(m_n\to\infty\) and \(m_n/n\to0\); all remaining observations form the main sample.
sampling_model.units: At index \(n\), the observed law is \(\mathbb P_n=\bigotimes_{r\in\mathcal R}P_{r,n}^{\otimes n_r}\), with fixed \(R\), fixed \(J\), and stable positive group fractions. Disjoint pilot and main subsamples are independent because sampling is iid within every primitive group and groups are mutually independent.
sampling_model.treatment: Treatment is a fixed realized group-level assignment. Causal interpretation is conditional on consistency, a nonempty exact-zero donor set, and the shared-slope additive untreated-change restriction. These are substantive crux assumptions; sample ranking or near-balance does not imply them.
sampling_model.overlap: Every primitive group has a positive limiting sampling fraction. No treatment-propensity overlap condition is used. Weak separation concerns donor scores approaching the union of exact-zero faces, including faces with several zero labels.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Group means and centered within-group covariances are estimated directly. The known contrast matrix propagates all covariance caused by shared treated groups and reused controls, and eigenvalue clipping keeps every inverse totalized. The pilot uses only score means. Conditional on its retained label set, the untouched main sample calibrates the maximum of scalar score-residualized effect errors, including within-label outcome uncertainty; a singleton retained set therefore uses \(\Phi^{-1}(1-\alpha/2)\).

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Their Proposition 3 recovers conventional inference when one argmax-selected option is chosen with probability tending to one; their selection rule and selected-option estimand differ from an exact-zero donor face.
Their Bayes--minimax result assumes dominated product-measurable laws and fixed sigma-finite expected-measure loss, so it is used only as a template for the unresolved general score-face program.
Simultaneous inference supplies universal post-selection coverage at a possible multiplicity cost.
Weak-identification subsequence arguments motivate uniformity but do not establish Le Cam transfer for the score-only donor-face experiment.
Conditional Gaussian inference motivates identification-strength robustness but does not solve the donor-face expected-diameter problem.
Few-treated-group difference-in-differences inference handles unequal group sizes using many controls rather than many iid micro observations inside fixed labels.
Cross-fitted synthetic-control inference concerns time-series average effects, not exact-zero donor-label uncertainty.
Global deficiency equivalence there uses domination, smoothness, positivity, compactness, and explicit likelihood-process approximation beyond the present fourth-moment panel class.

body.tldr: A fixed finite menu of donor stacks is nonregular when validity means exact equality of a noisy pretreatment score. Under the explicit nonempty-close and shared-slope additive untreated-change assumptions, exact score equality transports the donor contrast to the same ATT for every close label. The spectrally clipped projected hull is uniformly honest and root-\(n\) tight under fixed separation, but its all-label critical value is not oracle-equivalent. An independent \(o(n)\) pilot now screens labels, and scalar residual-effect calibration on the untouched sample remains uniformly honest, recovers the exact close face under fixed separation, and has ordinary one-label Wald endpoints when that face is a singleton. The original full-vector Gaussian frontier is infinite and its noisy-effect limit is mis-scaled; the repaired finite frontier observes donor effects exactly, places Gaussian noise only on root-\(n\)-scaled scores, and bounds their spread. Its two-face Mahalanobis subproblem has an exact likelihood-ratio value and zero-diameter elbow, while only the exact general-\(J\) constant and a suitably restricted score-only transfer remain unresolved. Ranked near-balance does not validate the historical CMS estimates.

project_justification.gap: Existing few-treated panel methods, long-time-series synthetic-control methods, and argmax post-selection methods do not give an honest confidence set for an ATT whose admissible label is defined by an exact population-zero score. The original maximum-critical hull also cannot supply an oracle first-order constant merely because false profiles disappear, and a full Gaussian experiment with fixed noise in donor effects has the wrong local scaling.
project_justification.niche: The motivating CMS workflow has finitely many prespecified comparison labels, many iid beneficiary-level observations within each state, unequal group sizes, and covariance from treated or control groups reused across labels. The mathematical class is narrower than the historical workflow: it explicitly requires at least one exact close donor and a shared-slope additive model for untreated changes. Its zero-face selection rule and common-face ATT are neither a special case nor a superclass of argmax selection with a selected-option estimand.
project_justification.fill: The note proves exact-score causal transport, shared-covariance Gaussian inversion, uniform coverage, and fixed-separation root-\(n\) tightness. It adds an independent vanishing-pilot procedure that is uniformly honest and recovers ordinary known-label Wald endpoints for a unique separated close donor. It also replaces the infinite, mis-scaled full-vector frontier by a bounded-spread score-only Gaussian problem, derives the exact two-face Mahalanobis benchmark and a finite simultaneous upper bound, and leaves only the exact general-\(J\) constant and restricted score-only experiment transfer open.

body.related_work: RTI International documents a CMS comparison-state workflow based on ranked baseline distance, retention of two or three states, claims-driven substitutions, and person-level weighting; the reviewed source does not document ex ante algebraic equality to known administrative population totals. The exact-face results therefore supply a falsifiable abstract design analysis, not validation of the historical estimates. Conley--Taber and Ferman--Pinto use many controls to form reference distributions for few treated groups, unlike the present fixed labels with many within-group micro observations. Chernozhukov--Wuthrich--Zhu study cross-fitted and self-normalized synthetic-control average-effect inference under time-series asymptotics, not latent exact-zero donor faces. Berk et al. motivate simultaneous insurance and its multiplicity cost. Andrews--Kitagawa--McCloskey select an observed argmax option and target its attached mean; the present rule selects latent population-zero faces and targets their common ATT, so neither model contains the other without changing both selection and estimand. Their Proposition 3 motivates, but does not prove, the independent-pilot oracle-equivalence theorem. Evans--Hansen--Stark provide only a decision-dual template here because their theorem requires dominated product-measurable laws and minimizes expected size under a fixed sigma-finite measure, conditions not yet reduced to this expected-diameter problem. Andrews--Cheng, Andrews--Mikusheva, and Nussbaum motivate weak-limit and equivalence questions but do not provide the missing score-only transfer under the present assumptions.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The original full-vector Gaussian minimax risk is infinite when donor-effect spread is unrestricted, and a limit experiment with fixed Gaussian noise in \(b\) is incompatible with the root-\(n\)-consistent post-mean vector. The repaired local problem therefore observes \(b\) exactly, places Gaussian noise only on scaled scores, and bounds \(\max_j b_j-\min_j b_j\). The exact two-face Mahalanobis value and a finite simultaneous upper bound do not determine the exact general-\(J\), multiple-face constant. Evans--Hansen--Stark duality remains a proposed template until domination, product measurability, and a valid reduction from diameter to fixed-measure loss are established. Raw-data Le Cam equivalence is not claimed; only a restricted score-only reduced-experiment transfer could be pursued with additional QMD and uniform-integrability conditions. Local face coherence is an explicit Gaussian restriction unless a bounded-slope local subfamily is separately imposed; it does not follow from \(h_j=0\) alone.
body.honest_scope: Uniform coverage is conditional on the exact-close triangular-array class, including consistency, nonempty exact close sets, the almost-sure shared-slope additive untreated-change model, uniform fourth moments, covariance eigenvalue bounds, and stable group fractions. The original projected hull is only claimed to be root-\(n\) tight under fixed separation; it retains an all-\(J\) critical value. The independent-pilot hull is uniformly honest because selection is independent of main-sample calibration, and it is oracle-equivalent only under fixed separation with a unique close label. Multiple close labels are recovered as a face and calibrated jointly. Diagnostics may falsify calibration, placebo fit, omitted-predictor balance, or donor support, but cannot turn ranked sample near-balance into exact population equality. The bounded-spread score-only Gaussian frontier is finite and has an exact two-face subproblem; exact general-\(J\) optimality and restricted score-only transfer remain open. The historical CMS estimates are not validated by these conditional results.
body.interpretation: The causal target remains \(\tau_n\), defined from potential outcomes. A close donor identifies it only through the proved transport equation \(b_{j,n}-\tau_n=\beta_n^{\top}s_{j,n}\), not by definition. The finite-sample confidence sets are observed-law functionals of group means and covariances. Exact zero scores and the untreated-change model connect those functionals to the causal target; without either premise they are only comparison-state contrasts. The adaptive pilot changes the calibration constant, not the estimand or the identifying restriction.
